chapters.summary: Joel declares that the locust plague and the drought are signs that the day of the LORD is drawing near, and calls the people to repent, fast, and cry out to God.
keyPoints: The locusts strip the vines and fig trees bare, silencing all joy and gladness.
The prophet calls the priests, farmers, and all the people to fast, weep, and cry out to the LORD in the temple.
He warns that the day of the LORD is near, coming as destruction from the Almighty.
chapters.application: When we face loss or disaster in life, let us examine ourselves, humbly repent, and seek God's mercy, for he is gracious and full of steadfast love.

chapters.summary: Joel 2 describes the day of the LORD drawing near; the prophet calls the people to repent, and God promises to pour out his Spirit and restore his blessing.
keyPoints: The prophet uses the locust plague as a picture of the day of the LORD, warning the people to tremble before it.
He calls the people to fast, weep, and turn to God with all their heart, asking God to relent from judgment.
God promises to pour out his Spirit, that whoever calls on the name of the LORD will be saved, and to restore Judah's abundance.
chapters.application: When we face hardship in life, let us examine our hearts and turn back to God in sincere repentance, trusting that his mercy and grace will surely bring restoration and hope.

chapters.summary: Joel 3 declares God's judgment on the nations and promises salvation for Judah and Jerusalem, culminating in the LORD reigning as King in Zion.
keyPoints: God gathers all nations to the valley of Jehoshaphat to judge them for oppressing his people.
The nations will be repaid for selling the people of Judah into slavery, and God will bring the captives home.
The LORD reigns in Zion, Judah enjoys everlasting peace, while the nations are destroyed.
chapters.application: When we face injustice, let us trust that God is a righteous judge who will surely vindicate the wronged. May we live out righteousness ourselves and hold fast to the certainty that his promises will be fulfilled.
